description: §39.2 positive control for the E-SCHEMA-014 `LIKE` case — a column NAMED `like`: quoted (`"like" TEXT`), or unquoted with its type followed by a constraint (`like TEXT NOT NULL`). Neither is a template reference; the E-SCHEMA-* family stays silent.
rationale: §39.2: only `LIKE <name>` followed by `INCLUDING`, `EXCLUDING`, `,` or `)` is a template reference; a quoted `like` column, or a `like` column whose type is followed by anything else, is an ordinary column. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "stamp all" (ii).
